caption:
Not every wall needs to be knocked down. Some just need walking around.

Thursday’s energy is Yang Water over Earth: a wide river meeting its banks. Lots of drive, lots of ideas, and some real limits. The banks aren’t the enemy; they give the river its direction.

3 small things for everyone today:
1. Plan the big thing, then trim it
2. Take a walk near water
3. Clear out one old file or drawer

How today meets your own chart is different. Your personal tips are free at the link in bio.
